module: GE extension that feeds the police pursuit UI: it reads gameplay_police.getPursuitData every GUI frame and publishes the 'policePursuit' stream (level, visibility, arrest and evade gauges, duration, flags). It also pushes alerts (PoliceAlertPush / PoliceAlertClear) for offenses and for the end of a pursuit. By default it follows the player's vehicle, unless M.targetId is set.
usage:
ui_policeInfo.targetId = vehId   -- follow another vehicle
ui_policeInfo.showFinalStats = false
local active = ui_policeInfo.isPursuit()
notes: Adjustable fields: targetId (nil = player), showFinalStats (true: shows score/offenses/units at the end; false: shows only success/failure) and enabled (false stops the automatic updates). The automatic extraction shifted their comments; the actual definitions are in the code.
liveData.state: 0 inactive, 1 pursuit, 2 end (arrest or evade finished). In state 2 the data is frozen until onPursuitStatsEnded or the resumption of a pursuit.
In onPursuitAction, the pursuit data is read with M.targetId (nil = player) and not with vehId.
The arrest/evade gauges are smoothed by lerp(…, 0.5) when they drop to zero, for a smooth progress bar.

enabled.desc: Default true. Set to false to disable the automatic updates and alerts.

showFinalStats.desc: Default true. Set to false to not show the summary (score, offenses, units) at the end of a pursuit.

targetId.desc: If set, uses the pursuit data of this vehicle instead of the player's.

isPursuit.desc: Indicates whether a pursuit is or has been active (liveData state > 0, including the end screen).

resetPursuitTable.desc: Resets all numbers and flags of liveData to zero, clears the alerts (PoliceAlertClear) and republishes the 'policePursuit' stream.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when the controlled vehicle changes; resets the table if the extension is enabled and without targetId.

onPursuitOffense.desc: Hook called when an offense is committed during a pursuit; pushes a 3 s alert (text ui.apps.police.offenseAlert with the translated name ui.traffic.infractions.<name>) if the vehicle is the target or the player.

onPursuitAction.desc: Hook called for a pursuit action. On 'arrest' or 'evade': switches to state 2, sets the corresponding gauge to 1, clears the alerts and shows either the summary (score, number of offenses, roadblocks or police units), or a simple failure/success depending on showFinalStats.

onPursuitStatsEnded.desc: Hook called when the pursuit end statistics are finished; resets the table if in state 2.

onUiChangedState.desc: Hook called when the UI changes state; resets the table.

onGuiUpdate.desc: Hook called every GUI frame: reads the pursuit data, updates level, visibility, gauges, duration (format m:ss or h:mm:ss) and flags, then publishes 'policePursuit'. Does nothing if be:getEnabled() is false or if the extension is disabled.
